events.title: Investigation assessment
events.detail: Checkout incident is symptomatic of a missing origin diagnostic. All services downstream of checkout (storefront, payments, ledger) are affected. The policy block explicitly prohibits any recovery action due to absence of origin diagnostics. Historical outcomes (INC-2041, INC-2042) show that disabling a feature flag resolved the issue, but only when origin logs and request traces were available. Current evidence lacks these diagnostics, and no action is justified under current policy. The root cause remains unconfirmed, and no recovery action is authorizable.

INC-2043
data.summary: Checkout requests return HTTP 503. Origin telemetry is unavailable.

Payments v2.4 introduced strict_currency_validation, rejecting legacy currency strings. This causes checkout and storefront failures. The ledger schema 1 advisory permits rollback to payments v2.3. The impact graph shows checkout and storefront failures via dependency chains. Rollback is supported by current compatibility policy.

Payments v2.4's strict_currency_validation is rejecting legacy currency strings. Ledger schema 2 is active and blocks rollback to v2.3. The runtime flag can be disabled to accept legacy strings without deployment rollback. This action is permitted by current policy and resolves the validation error at the source.
